name: What does an interior layout reconfiguration involve?

mainEntity.name: What does an interior layout reconfiguration involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: An interior layout reconfiguration involves altering the existing floor plan of your home to improve flow, functionality, or room size. Unlike simple cosmetic remodeling, it often includes removing or framing new walls, altering doorways, and relocating fixtures. At HH Remodeling, owner Abraham Becerra handles the structural framing, drywall, and finish carpentry while coordinating licensed sub-trades to reroute hidden electrical, plumbing, or HVAC lines running through altered partitions. The scope depends heavily on whether walls are load-bearing, which determines whether structural support beams are necessary.
acceptedAnswer.description: It involves changing your home's floor plan by moving or removing walls, altering doorways, and coordinating sub-trades to reroute plumbing and electrical lines.
